name: Upscale
what: Makes a picture two or four times larger and sharper, without adding anything that was not there.
how: 4x-UltraSharp, an ESRGAN upscaling network, runs on Comfy Cloud: it re-draws the picture at four times its size, sharpening edges and fine texture, and the result is scaled back to 2x when you ask for 2x. It restores detail; it does not invent new objects or change the content.
goodFor: sharpen a small or blurry picture
limits: very blurry faces stay soft: it sharpens, it does not reconstruct a face
4x of a large picture makes a very large file
use: Drop a picture on the well (or pick one from your library)
Compare before and after with the slider, then keep or hand it to another tool

name: Remove background
what: Cuts the subject out of a picture and leaves it on a clear (transparent) background.
how: BiRefNet, a segmentation model, finds the main subject and draws a precise mask around it (hair and fine edges included); the background is made transparent and the result is saved as a PNG with alpha. It runs on Comfy Cloud in a few seconds.
goodFor: product photo on white or clear
lift the product off the table
limits: several subjects may come out together
glass and smoke edges can be rough
use: Drop the picture on the well
The result is a PNG on a checker: download it or hand it to Upscale, Relight or a video tool

name: Variations
what: Makes four new takes of a picture: the same subject and style, in another moment, pose or framing.
how: The picture model you picked in the app (Qwen Image 2.1 Edit by default, or a partner model such as GPT Image) is given your picture as a reference with a prompt to keep the subject and look and change the moment; it draws four pictures at about one megapixel.
goodFor: more options of the same picture
a few alternatives for a post
limits: identity can drift a little between takes
text in the picture is not kept exactly
use: Drop the picture on the well
Optionally say what to vary (the light, the pose, the season)
Press Vary: about 11 cr for four

name: Edit with words
what: Changes what you describe in a picture and keeps the rest as it is.
how: An instruction-following image editing model (Qwen Image 2.1 Edit by default, or the partner model picked in the app) reads your picture and your sentence, then re-draws only what the sentence asks to change: an object, the time of day, the clothes, the background.
goodFor: change the background of a photo
remove a person from a photo
change the colour of the product
edit a picture with a sentence
limits: big changes can alter faces
exact text and logos are not reliable
use: Drop the picture on the well
Say what to change in one sentence ("make it night, keep the person")
Compare, then edit again or keep

name: Extend
what: Makes a clip go on for a few more seconds, continuing what happens in it.
how: LTX-2.5 on Comfy Cloud starts from the last frames of your clip and generates what comes next, guided by your words if you give them; picture and sound are made together, and the new part is joined to the end of the clip.
limits: 2 to 10 seconds at a time
faces and fine details can drift in the new part
use: Drop a clip (or pick a take or a result)
Press Extend: about 24 cr for 5 s

name: Lip-sync
what: Makes a photo of a face say or sing a voice track, with its lips moving to the words.
how: LTX-2.5 on Comfy Cloud animates your photo as the first frame of a clip and is conditioned on the voice track, so the mouth, head and expression follow the speech or the song; the voice is laid on the clip.
goodFor: a talking head from a photo
limits: up to 10 seconds of voice per clip
the face should be clear and facing the camera
use: Drop a photo of a face
Drop the voice track (a recording, a song's vocals, or a voice made with Voice from text)
Optionally say how they say it
Press Lip-sync: about 24 cr for 5 s

name: Add sound
what: Writes a soundtrack for a silent clip that follows what happens on screen.
how: LTX-2.5 keeps your clip's picture frozen and generates only its audio, conditioned on the picture and on your words, so steps, impacts and ambience land in sync with the motion. Foley mode adds a LoRA that keeps it to real sounds (no music).
limits: about the first 10 seconds of a clip
music is better made with Music and laid with Mute or swap audio
use: Say what we should hear ("rain on the window, a car passing")
Turn on Foley for real sounds only
Press Add sound: about 9 cr for 5 s

name: Upscale video
what: Restores a clip at a larger size (720p, 1080p or 1440p), sharper, frame by frame.
how: SeedVR2 (3B), a video restoration model, runs on Comfy Cloud: it upscales the frames together, so detail is re-drawn consistently from one frame to the next instead of flickering; the sound is kept.
limits: about 12 seconds per run
it sharpens; it does not fix bad motion
use: Press Upscale: about 27 cr for 5 s

name: Music
what: Makes a music track from a few words, with lyrics or as an instrumental.
how: ACE-Step 1.5 (turbo) on Comfy Cloud reads your style words (genre, mood, instruments), your lyrics if any, the length and the tempo, and generates the whole track as audio in one go.
limits: 10 to 240 seconds
lyrics in sections sing best; for full songs use Jam
use: Describe the style in a few words ("warm acoustic folk, upbeat")
Optionally write lyrics; leave empty for an instrumental
Set the length and the tempo
Press Make the track: about 10 cr for 30 s

name: Sound effect
what: Makes a sound effect or an ambience from a sentence, in four variations.
how: Stable Audio 3 (small, sound effects) on Comfy Cloud turns your sentence into audio in a few denoising steps; four variations are made at once so you can pick the best.
limits: 1 to 30 seconds
speech and music are not its job
use: Describe the sound ("heavy rain on a tin roof, distant thunder")
Press Make the sound: about 4 cr
Play the variations and keep one, or drop it on the Mixing strip

name: Voice from text
what: Says a text in a natural voice, or in the voice of a short recording you give it.
how: Chatterbox TTS (open model) runs the official template on Comfy Cloud: it reads your text and speaks it; given a few seconds of a voice, it copies that voice's timbre. An exaggeration setting makes it calmer or more expressive.
limits: English works best
long texts are better split into lines
use: Optionally give a short clean recording of the voice to copy
Hand it to Lip-sync or the Mixing strip

name: Voice clone
what: Says your recording again in another voice, keeping its words and timing.
how: Chatterbox voice conversion (open model, official template on Comfy Cloud) keeps the words, rhythm and intonation of your recording and replaces the voice with the one in the reference clip.
goodFor: dub a line in a character's voice
limits: needs a clean reference voice of a few seconds
noise in the recording carries over
use: Give the voice to speak in (a short clean clip)

name: Split stems
what: Pulls a track apart into its vocals and its instruments.
how: MelBandRoFormer, a source separation model (official template on Comfy Cloud), splits the track's spectrum into a vocal stem and an instrumental stem you can use on their own.
limits: two stems (vocals and the rest)
use: Each stem comes back as its own sound

name: Clean up and denoise
what: Takes hiss, hum and room noise out of a recording.
how: FFmpeg runs on this machine: a high-pass filter cuts rumble and hum, then afftdn (FFT noise reduction) learns the noise floor and lowers it by the amount you set. Free and private.
limits: very loud noise cannot be removed without artefacts
use: Set the amount (start around 14) and a high-pass if there is hum

name: Master and loudness
what: Brings a sound to the loudness a platform asks for, without clipping.
how: FFmpeg, on this machine, measures the sound with loudnorm (EBU R128) in a first pass, then sets it to the target (Streaming -14 LUFS, Social -16, Broadcast -23 or your own) with a true-peak limit. Free.
limits: it sets loudness; it does not mix or EQ

name: Find the beat
what: Reads the tempo (BPM) and the beats of a track.
how: The page decodes the track in your browser and detects its onsets and tempo with the app's beat tracker, then shows the BPM and the beat grid on the waveform. Free, nothing is sent anywhere.
limits: very free tempo music has no steady grid
use: Copy the BPM or read the beats

name: Mixing strip
what: Lays up to six sounds on a timeline, sets their levels and renders one mixed sound.
how: You place sounds on tracks with offsets and volumes in the page; the server mixes them with ffmpeg (adelay, volume, amix) and can master the result to a loudness target. Free.
goodFor: mix music and a voice over
limits: six tracks
use: Add sounds from your library to the tracks
Drag them in time, set each fader

name: Remove an object
what: Erases an object or a person from a clip and fills the space as if it was never there.
how: On Comfy Cloud, VOID (or Obscura Remova on LTX 2.3, or Wan VACE) finds what you name in every frame and paints it out, shadows included, keeping the background consistent over time. For a still camera, a free mode paints out a spot you brush on (ffmpeg removelogo).
goodFor: remove a person from a video
remove a logo from a clip
limits: about 12 seconds per run
the free mode only works for a still spot on a still camera
use: Say what to remove ("the man in the yellow jacket") or paint the spot for the free mode
Press Remove it: about 35 cr for 5 s on Cloud, free for a painted spot

name: Replace the background
what: Puts a new background behind the people in a clip, or takes it out entirely.
how: A partner service (Bria) separates the people from the background in every frame on Comfy Cloud and composites them over the picture you give, or leaves the background transparent.
goodFor: change the background of a video
limits: partner credits, priced at the run
best with people as the subject
use: Pick New background (and give the picture) or No background
Press Change it and confirm the partner's price

name: Green-screen cutout
what: Takes out a green or blue screen and keeps the subject, with a clear background.
how: FFmpeg runs on this machine: chromakey removes the colour you pick (with similarity and blend to soften edges) and despill cleans the green that spills onto the subject; the result is a WebM or MOV with alpha, or over a colour. Free.
limits: needs an evenly lit screen behind the subject
use: Pick the screen colour on the picture

name: Relight
what: Changes the light and the mood of a picture (or of a clip, with a partner).
how: For a picture, Qwen Image Edit with a relighting LoRA (official template on Comfy Cloud) re-renders the light you describe (golden side light, neon, overcast) and keeps the subject. For a clip, Beeble SwitchX (partner) relights it to match a reference picture.
goodFor: change the lighting of a photo
match the light of two pictures
limits: the clip mode is a partner service, priced at the run
use: Pick a light or describe it

name: Restyle
what: Turns a clip into another look (anime, clay, film noir, watercolour) while keeping its motion.
how: Wan VACE 14B (open model, official template on Comfy Cloud) re-draws every frame in the style you describe while following the original motion and layout; a partner option (Runway Aleph 2) does it from a few words.
goodFor: a different art style for a clip
limits: about 5 seconds per run
faces change with the style
use: Pick a style or describe one
Press Restyle: about 32 cr for 5 s

name: Add rain, snow or fog
what: Lays rain, snow or fog over a clip as an overlay effect.
how: FFmpeg, on this machine, draws the weather procedurally (noise, motion blur and geq patterns) at the amount, speed and angle you set, then blends it over your clip in screen mode. It is an overlay: nothing in the scene gets wet. Free.
limits: an overlay effect, not simulated weather
use: Pick rain, snow or fog and set amount, speed and angle

name: Stabilise
what: Takes the shake out of a handheld shot.
how: FFmpeg, on this machine, runs vid.stab in two passes: the first tracks the camera's motion, the second smooths it and re-frames each picture, zooming a little to hide the moving edges. Free.
limits: very fast shakes blur in the frame and stay blurred

name: Slow motion
what: Makes smooth slow motion by creating the frames between the frames.
how: Free mode: ffmpeg's minterpolate estimates motion between frames and builds the in-between ones. AI mode: FILM frame interpolation (official template on Comfy Cloud) makes cleaner in-betweens on fast motion.
goodFor: slow down a clip without stutter
limits: fast motion can smear in the free mode
use: Press Slow it: free, or about 4 cr with AI

name: Face and skin retouch
what: Evens out skin in a portrait and brings back its natural texture.
how: A partner model (Magnific skin enhancer, official template on Comfy Cloud) smooths blemishes and uneven tone and restores skin texture so the face does not look plastic.
limits: partner credits, priced at the run
pictures only
use: Press Retouch and confirm the partner's price

name: Colour grade and LUTs
what: Opens the Edit workspace's colour grade: looks, curves and .cube LUTs.
how: This card is a shortcut: the grade itself lives in Edit (ffmpeg eq, curves, colour balance and lut3d on this machine). Free.
use: Press Open it: it opens Edit's Grade colour

name: Add particles and sparks
what: Lays sparks, embers or drifting dust over a clip.
how: FFmpeg, on this machine, draws particles procedurally (bright points with motion trails and blur) at the amount, speed and direction you set, and blends them over the clip. An overlay. Free.
limits: an overlay effect
use: Pick sparks, embers or dust and set amount, speed and direction

name: Trim
what: Keeps one part of a clip.
how: FFmpeg cuts the clip between your in and out points; on keyframes it copies the stream without re-encoding (instant, no loss), otherwise it re-encodes that part.
use: Drag the in and out handles on the strip

name: Crop and reframe
what: Fits a clip to 9:16, 1:1, 4:5 or 16:9.
how: FFmpeg crops a window you place (or centres it), scales it, and fills what is left with a blurred copy, a colour or nothing. There is no subject tracking: you place the window.
limits: the window does not follow the subject
use: Drag the frame where the subject is

name: Speed and slow-mo
what: Makes a clip faster or slower (0.25x to 4x).
how: FFmpeg retimes the picture (setpts) and the sound (atempo, pitch kept); smooth mode builds in-between frames with minterpolate for slow motion.
use: Turn on Smooth for slow motion

name: Reverse
what: Plays a clip backwards, sound too.
how: FFmpeg reverses the frames and the audio of the clip.
limits: long clips need memory

name: Loop
what: Repeats a clip, or plays it back and forth (ping-pong).
how: FFmpeg concatenates the clip N times, or the clip and its reverse for a seamless ping-pong.
use: Set how many times, or Ping-pong

name: Merge clips
what: Joins several clips in order, with a crossfade.
how: FFmpeg scales the clips to one size and joins them with xfade (picture) and acrossfade (sound), or straight cuts.

name: Add captions
what: Puts words on the picture, typed or from an .srt or .vtt file.
how: FFmpeg burns the subtitles into the picture with the app's fonts (the subtitles filter), in the style, size, colour and position you pick.
limits: captions are burned in, not a separate track
use: Type the lines with their times, or drop an .srt

name: Grade colour
what: Gives a clip a look: presets, sliders and .cube LUTs.
how: FFmpeg applies exposure, contrast and saturation (eq), curves, warmth and tint (colour balance), a vignette, and your LUT (lut3d).
use: Pick a preset or move the sliders, or load a .cube LUT

name: Add a logo
what: Puts a picture (a logo, a watermark) over a clip, in a corner.
how: FFmpeg overlays your picture at the corner, size and opacity you pick, with optional fades.
use: Give the logo (a PNG with a clear background is best)

name: Mute or swap audio
what: Takes a clip's sound out, replaces it or mixes another under it.
how: FFmpeg drops the clip's audio, maps a new sound in its place, or mixes the two (amix) with the volumes you set and an optional fade out.
use: Pick Mute, Replace or Mix and give the sound

name: Convert format
what: Saves a clip as MP4, WebM, MOV or GIF, or keeps only its sound.
how: FFmpeg re-encodes the clip with the codec, quality, size and frame rate you pick (H.264, VP9, ProRes, GIF, MP3, WAV, M4A).

name: GIF and thumbnails
what: Makes a GIF of a range, or saves frames as pictures.
how: FFmpeg builds a palette for the range (palettegen) and encodes a clean GIF with it (paletteuse), or exports frames as PNG or JPG at even times or the times you set.
limits: GIFs get heavy past a few seconds
use: Pick GIF or Frames and the range

name: Template
what: Runs any of the official ComfyUI workflows on Comfy Cloud, from a form made from its inputs.
how: The Library reads Comfy Cloud's own catalogue (about 695 official workflows); a workflow's form comes from its inputs, its price from Cloud's estimate, and Cloud converts and runs it when you confirm. What it makes comes back as a result.
goodFor: a job no tool on the shelf does
use: Find the workflow in the Library (search or browse)
Press Run on Comfy Cloud and confirm the price
